# Visit Modoc County

> Unofficial, community-made visitor guide to Modoc County in the far northeast corner of California: wilderness, fishing, hiking, wildlife, hot springs, volcanic caves, and small towns like Alturas and Cedarville. Created pro bono with no affiliate links or monetization. Not affiliated with Modoc County government or any official tourism agency.

Business details (hours, menus, lodging availability) change often in a rural county. Treat listings on this site as a starting point and confirm current details with the business directly. Menu items mentioned on merchant pages are a few highlights, not complete menus.

## Main guide

- [Home](https://visit-modoc.com/): Overview of Modoc County and what makes it worth the trip
- [Things to Do](https://visit-modoc.com/things-to-do): Fishing, hiking, Lava Beds National Monument caves, wildlife viewing, hunting, and other outdoor activities
- [Places to Visit](https://visit-modoc.com/places-to-visit): Towns and scenic destinations, including Alturas, Cedarville, and Lava Beds National Monument
- [Where to Stay](https://visit-modoc.com/where-to-stay): Hotels and motels, campgrounds, RV parks, and vacation rentals
- [Where to Eat](https://visit-modoc.com/where-to-eat): Restaurants by town and cuisine, plus groceries and supplies
- [Plan Your Visit](https://visit-modoc.com/plan-your-visit): Getting here, when to visit, what to bring, and current weather

## Town guides

- [Alturas](https://visit-modoc.com/alturas): The county seat and largest town: lodging, dining, groceries, attractions, and services
- [Cedarville](https://visit-modoc.com/cedarville): Surprise Valley town near hot springs and the Warner Mountains: lodging, dining, and local businesses

## Local businesses

- [The Vault](https://visit-modoc.com/merchants/the-vault): Independent coffee house in historic downtown Cedarville
- [Valley Farm Store](https://visit-modoc.com/merchants/valley-farm-store): Farm store and cafe on Main Street in Cedarville

## Optional

- [Webcams](https://visit-modoc.com/webcams): Public Caltrans, ALERTCalifornia, and TripCheck cameras for road and weather conditions in and around the county
- [Bartell's Backroads in Modoc](https://visit-modoc.com/bartells-backroads): ABC10 video episodes filmed in Modoc County
- [Technical Details](https://visit-modoc.com/technical-details): Photo credits, licensing, and contact information

The text and code of this website are dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0. The photographs are not: each keeps its own license (public domain, Creative Commons, or used with credit from the business that owns it), as listed on the Technical Details page.
